title: Indicator as a character sum
statement:
Let $k \ge 1$ and write $\omega_k = e^{2\pi i/k}$ for the primitive $k$-th root of unity. For every $a \in \mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$,
\[
  \mathbf{1}[a = 0] \;=\; \frac{1}{k}\,\operatorname{Re}\!\left(\sum_{j \in \mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}} \omega_k^{\,ja}\right),
\]
where the exponent $ja$ is computed in $\mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$ and then lifted to its canonical representative in $\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$, and the left-hand side equals $1$ when $a = 0$ and $0$ otherwise.
